description: Two-book strategy classification (docs/INVESTMENTS-PAGE-SPEC.md, 'Strategy model & policy deviations'). CORE = $1T+ durables: never sell, delta-10 covered calls, forced exits must be recovered (re-buy or sell puts until re-assigned). INVENTORY = volatile wheel names: sell puts for premium, on assignment exit via delta-20 calls; holding them passively is the deviation. Symbols are Neel's declaration, not an API lookup — edit here when policy changes. Seeded by Claude 2026-07-12 from known market caps; TSLA and IBIT classifications flagged for Neel's review.
